env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
go get example.com/godep@v1.0.0
logos run .
stdout '^godep: godep hello$'
cp stdout $WORK/run-stdout.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/go.mod
grep '^require example\.com/godep v1\.0\.0' out/go.mod
! grep '^replace example\.com/godep' out/go.mod
! exists out/_logos_deps/example.com/godep@v1.0.0

cd out
go mod tidy
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/run-stdout.txt
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/goreq

go 1.27

require example.com/godep v1.0.0

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/godep"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println("godep:", godep.Hello)
}
